name: Admin Diagnostic Sections Editor
description: Admin edits the 8 JSON sections from the Secciones tab of the diagnostic edit page. Each section type has a typed form (paragraphs, severity levels, 14-category findings, radiography table, timeline rows, etc.). Changes are debounced and PATCHed to /sections/<id>/update/. The tab also exposes a completeness indicator (% + colored progress bar counting enabled sections with non-empty content_json) and a per-section 'Restaurar contenido por defecto' action (POST /sections/<id>/reset/). Raw-JSON read + bulk apply moved to the JSON tab — see admin-diagnostic-json-export / admin-diagnostic-json-import.
